_readme: Secret Diary prompt pool. This file is the ONLY place prompts live — edit it directly.
Each prompt: id (stable, never reuse or renumber — prompt logs reference it), text, type ('written' | 'yesno'), level ('mild' | 'spicy' | 'unhinged').

To add one: append it to its group with the next unused number for its type-level (check _retired too). To reword one, edit its text and keep its id — it's still the same question. To retire one: delete it and add its id to _retired — a retired id is never reused.
'yesno' prompts are statements a player answers yes or no to about themselves.
